content: T2HELIX v0.0.5 SHIPPED — 2026-05-11, commit 97da060. All five hooks now live on main: UserPromptSubmit (recall), PreToolUse (compass), PostToolBatch (goal coherence), PreCompact (archive before context compression), Stop (session synthesis). SSE transport also merged. T2Helix now has the full self-improvement surface — hooks feed the chronicle, chronicle feeds recall, compass self-calibrates from override patterns. Multi-seat via SSE. Installable by anyone. This is the crown jewel milestone: a complete, public, adaptable tool any Claude user can run. Built across MacBook + Mac Studio + iPhone Claude seat in one day. Sovereign Stack remains infrastructure backbone; T2Helix is the user-facing jewel.
